snippet.title: Uncanny Tales: Cold Road - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
ADD TO WISHLIST STEAM!

Uncanny Tales is an episodic horror series where the scariest things aren’t monsters or the supernatural, but people themselves. Each episode tells a new chilling story inspired by real-life fears and unsettling situations.

The first episode is about a young woman on her way to her parents' house on New Year's Eve who has an accident on a snowy road. Seeking help, she finds a secluded house where she is warmly welcomed by her elderly landlady. At night, however, strange noises make her question the safety of the place.

Add it to your vishlist on Steam. Link in pinned comment.
